_readme: One entry per curated, kept-live report page. `covers` tags the real field/function names each
entry exercises (not prose descriptions) — when a load-bearing shape changes (e.g. `_measurePick`,
finds exactly which corpus entries are at risk and need re-verifying before/after the change.
baselineCapturedAt/lastVerifiedAt are stamped ONLY by probe_corpus.mjs itself (--capture / a clean
diff pass respectively) — never hand-edit them, they're the tool's own record of what it has
actually machine-checked, not a claim about when a human last looked at the page.

entries.notes: Representative for the plain (non-difference) LineGraph code path, 2-route travelTime. Session-scoped page from 2026-08-07 was cleaned up per feedback_golden_corpus_pages_session_scoped — rebuild from the spec before first --capture.

Representative for the BarGraph code path AND the Layer-3 known-good-value PoC (see expectedValue) — chosen because `speed` is a near-raw average, the class of measure the team is most confident is already correctly computed (any discrepancy is most likely rounding, not a wrong formula). Rebuild before first --capture, same as linegraph.

expectedValue.description: NY-9D Northbound (route 2195805, TMCs 120+29712/120+29713/120+29714) average speed, Monday (toDayOfWeek(date,1)=1), 2025-01-01..2025-02-28. Computed independently: per-TMC avgIf(travel_time_all_vehicles, !=0) via direct ClickHouse SQL against npmrds.s583_v982_NPMRDS_V6, summed, combined with per-TMC miles from the UDA view-3464 reference-data endpoint (a static geometry lookup, not derived from this report's own rendering), via the report's own formula (sum(miles)*3600/sum(avg_travel_time_s)). Matched the live rendered value EXACTLY (19.57234077140305, to 15 significant digits) when computed 2026-08-10 — confirms the speed formula is correct for this measure, not just close.
expectedValue.groundTruthQuery: dbq.py ch "SELECT tmc, avgIf(toFloat64(travel_time_all_vehicles), travel_time_all_vehicles != 0) AS avg_tt FROM npmrds.s583_v982_NPMRDS_V6 WHERE tmc IN ('120+29713','120+29712','120+29714') AND date >= '2025-01-01' AND date <= '2025-02-28' AND toDayOfWeek(date,1)=1 GROUP BY tmc" + UDA viewsById/3464 miles lookup for the same 3 TMCs; speed = sum(miles)*3600/sum(avg_tt)

entries.notes: Representative for the per-TMC/day heat-grid code path — see graph-new-single-categorize-limit memory (GridGraph's yAxis-not-categorize quirk lives here). Rebuild before first --capture.

Representative for the Route Map / choropleth-baking code path — a real per-report choropleth baked server-side at build time, distinct from the other AVL Graph types. Rebuild before first --capture; the bake step's own dependencies (dama-tiles pg) must be reachable, not just ClickHouse.

PRIORITY entry — the Dynamic Report / catalog-template code path. Re-baselined 2026-08-11: the real live page (old id 2210438, convert_old_reports.py-built) was DELETED and rebuilt fresh under the identical slug from the committed spec (new id 2210906) — no longer 'NOT spec-built'; that was true only before this round. Now 7 real panels (was 5 mid-round, briefly missing the 2 Bar Graph Summary ones until `resolution: "summary"` was built the same day — see report-spec-and-build-script.md's Dynamic Report follow-on for the full record). MUST keep the `?routes=` param (bypasses the Add-Routes entry-gate modal deterministically) — probing the bare slug tests only the empty-slot placeholder state, see report-probe-expect-and-golden-corpus.md's 2026-08-07 finding. `authRequired: false` confirmed live 2026-08-10 (renders publicly with real data despite the row's own `published` field reading back empty — that field isn't what gates public rendering here). Its Day-1..Day-5/Average-for-Week/Month/Year comps exercise the Today-anchor mechanism (`dateFormula`/`derivedFromRoute`/`TODAY_ANCHOR_COMP_ID`).

Added 2026-08-10 alongside the calendar-position grammar enrichment (see dynamic-reports-and-route-tags.md item 3) — the 12 individual-month comps (`comp-1`..`comp-12`) were migrated off frozen static dates onto `startDate=>calendar:{m}-1..{m}-L` derived from `__TODAY__`; this is the only corpus entry exercising that formula shape for a plain (non-wrapping) month. Several 'Hours of Delay' panels show EMPTY SVG even on a passing baseline — a pre-existing, unrelated per-year AADT-data-coverage gap (see the task doc), not something this entry's diff should ever flag as new. Months past the real ClickHouse data cliff (`SELECT max(date) FROM npmrds.s583_v982_NPMRDS_V6`) will legitimately have less content than earlier months at any given capture time — re-verify by re-running the probe, don't assume a diff here is a regression before checking the real cliff date first.

Re-baselined 2026-08-11: the real live page (old id 2210658, convert_old_reports.py-built) was DELETED and rebuilt fresh under the identical slug from the committed spec (new id 2211130) — no longer 'NOT spec-built'. 18 sections, 6 real routes (current_year/winter/winter_weekday/spring/summer/fall). The 5 seasonal-window comps' `calendar:` formulas (including the ONLY corpus example of the year-wrap case, Winter: `calendar:12-19..3-19` derived from `__TODAY__`) carried over unchanged from the earlier working round. Two real fixes made this round: (1) the 4 'Speed in <season> Compared to Year Average' difference GridGraphs had a dead anchor comp, re-pointed at the live Current Year route; (2) 3 of 4 seasons' 'Avg. Hours of Delay by Weekday' panels were missing (dead sub-routes) — reconstructed as one consolidated `bar_weekday_allseasons` graph using `resolution: weekday` on the live Avg Day routes directly. Dropped 1 graph needing the still-unbuilt avgHoursOfDelay+summary combo (3rd template needing it, after Single Route and This Month vs. Last Month vs. Last Year). Verified 2026-08-11: 0 console/page/SQL errors; 'Avg. Hours of Delay per Season by 5-Min' (LineGraph, avgHoursOfDelay) renders EMPTY — the same AADT-distributions-join data-coverage gap seen elsewhere for this test TMC, not a regression. 'Fall Average Day - Speed' and its diff graph render visibly sparser (1 rect vs. ~289 for the other 3 seasons) — explained, not a bug: Fall's window (`9-20..12-19`) is mostly FUTURE relative to today (2026-08-11), unlike Winter/Spring/Summer whose windows are fully in the past — most of Fall's range is beyond the real ClickHouse data cliff. Re-verify by checking the real cliff date before treating either as a regression.
